verdict.rationale: The docs say admins can view all users' shared meetings by configuring View permissions, and an API endpoint lists users with their permissions. Together these give some admin visibility into what is shared. The quickstart also distinguishes meetings 'recorded by you' from those 'shared to your team', which implies a sharing model, and folders are listed as a collaboration feature. missing for 10: evidence that notes are private by default, granular link-level and workspace-level sharing permissions, folder-level permission controls, an admin audit or report of shared links, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
